canon: Orcos de los clanes Maktor y Serhu: piel beige y arcilla curtida por el sol y el viento de la estepa, que se oscurece con la edad; complexión corpulenta pero de músculo largo y estilizado, hecha para las carreras de las cacerías rituales del Corredor de Cauce. Macho: trenzas negras atadas con cuero crudo, barba corta veteada de canas, colmillos largos marcados con patrones tribales rojos, cicatrices rituales en pecho y brazos; taparrabos, chaleco de cuero negro con el pecho al aire, capa de plumas cenicientas atada a la cintura, descalzo con tiras de cuero en los pies, hacha de guerra a dos manos de hierro negro. Hembra: colmillos anchos y largos, cabello negro veteado de rojo trenzado con cuentas de hueso, ojos ámbar muy separados, cicatrices rituales en los hombros.

prompt.sujeto: A full-length view of a huge, heavy-set orc crouched on the edge of a red rock cliff in the left third of the image, taken at chest height and turned three-quarters to the right, the whole figure from bare feet to the top of the hair filling almost the whole height of the frame.
prompt.proporcion: Crouched, the figure is four and a half heads tall, with shoulders nearly three heads wide and long, lean arms about two heads long, every muscle long and ropy rather than bulky with fat.
prompt.cuerpo: The head is heavy and square, with a jutting lower jaw, long ivory tusks pointing up from the lower lip and small pointed ears swept back. The skin is warm clay-beige, sand-coloured where the light touches it and deeper brown in shade, weathered dry by wind and heat, with pale healed streaks across the body.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: Strips of rawhide bind the feet and wrists, and thin red lines are painted in tribal patterns along both tusks.
prompt.pose: The back foot is flat on the rock and the front foot raised on a higher ledge, the weight leaning forward over the bent front knee, the head turned toward the valley.
prompt.entorno: Below the cliff a wide valley of red clay opens to the right, scattered with dark red hide tents and thin grey smoke, and beyond it layered red mesas meet a pale hazy horizon at the height of the chest.
prompt.luz: Bright, hazy daylight falls from high on the right and throws warm gold rim light over the shoulders and the edges of the tusks.

rasgos+: This male wears his black hair in long braids tied with rawhide, with a short black beard streaked with grey and pale healed streaks across his chest and arms.

He wears a loincloth of cured hide, an open black leather vest that leaves his chest bare and a cloak of ash-grey feathers knotted at the waist, and both hands grip a heavy two-handed war axe of black iron held across his body, its shaft nearly as long as he is tall.
This female has broad, long tusks, wide-set amber eyes and black hair streaked with red, braided with bone beads, with pale healed streaks across her shoulders and skin glistening with sweat.
She wears a dark leather bodice, a kilt of leather strips and a cloak of dark feathers, and grips a short iron axe in each hand, a strip of red cloth tied below each head.
hembra.pose: She charges mid-stride across the red ground toward the right, her weight on the front foot, both axes raised and her mouth open in a roar, her head turned three-quarters toward the viewer.
hembra.entorno: To the left stands a camp of red hide tents behind a palisade of sharpened stakes, and behind her to the right a war band of tusked warriors runs through the dust across a wide red plain toward low mesas on a pale hazy horizon.

momento:atardecer.luz: The low sun sits on the right behind thin haze and rims the shoulders, tusks and feathers with fiery orange light.

momento:noche.luz: Under a starry night sky with a soft, even pearly glow, a cool silver-blue light rims the shoulders and tusks, and deep cool shadows fill the valley below.
